log: No empty or repeated triangles were found.
Flat areas: 5 walls and other flat areas (6736 triangles) pressed onto their planes and lit as one face each. No point moved more than 0.11 percent of the part's size.

Windows: found 4 windows by shape (flat, upright, set back inside a frame, glass colored). 2 have a light on (material windows_lit) and 2 are dark (material windows_dark). The walls are untouched and nothing was moved.
Signs and doors: 4 doors (set back like a window, but painted or reaching the ground) named as material door, unchanged in look.

Walls: 4 walls and 4 roof slopes moved to a 2048 px texture of their own, one rectangle each at one even scale. The old paint was smoothed to its colors (stains, bands and corners stay, thin lines and creases go) and a new stucco surface was laid over it. Material walls. Nothing was moved.
Surfaces are scanned photographs (stucco, roof) laid at true size and tinted to the old paint.

Where a wall is far darker than its own usual color (a window, vent or door that is only painted on, with no step in the mesh) the old paint was kept as it was, so it is not smeared. A solid block of other paint half a meter or more across (a pale window, a brown door) is kept whole the same way and faded into the new wall at its edge.

Walls taken whole: 10124 loose triangles that lay in a wall's plane or reached from it into a painted window joined that wall, so no wedge of old paint is left across it. Where two sheets of a wall lay on each other, the one in front shows.
Roof: each slope is lit as one plane and its tiles come from the texture. The raised tiles of the mesh stay in place, so the eaves keep their shape.

Color standard: 2 color textures brought inside the shared range. Brightness ran from 0 to 39 percent and peak vividness was 49. Now 2 to 39 and 49. The middle of the range and every hue are untouched.
Surface maps: made 2 normal map links and 0 roughness map links from the color texture, for materials that had none. 3 materials kept the normal map it came with.
Reduced 1665224 triangles to 70236. The surface moved by at most 2.0 percent of the model size. Edges between parts were held in place.
The model was scaled by 3.4191, set on the ground, centered.
Textures: 1 resized to 2048 px or under. Saved 9.1 MB.
